answer: Each agent publishes a TXT record with the challenge hash on its domain and serves a matching TLS certificate within 10 minutes. Peers query the record and verify the chain, confirming the onyx signature matches the domain. One honest agent holds 1 domain at about $12 per year for a 150 POA bond, while 10 fakes must buy 10 domains with 10 certificates, turning a lagoon of cheap clones into one mesa of costs rising 10X. A missing record or mismatched certificate slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
